title: Implement manifest-driven V4 project and factory reset
goal: Implement safe Preview/Apply reset confined to recorded V4-owned mutable claims with exact acceptance hashes, receipts and idempotency.
acceptanceCriteria: Project and factory reset produce strict hash-bound manifests before deletion.
Apply recomputes and exactly matches the accepted manifest before touching any path.
PackageRoot, TargetRoot, unclaimed paths, links/reparse points and .git worktree/gitlink markers cannot be deleted.
Project reset affects only the selected binding and factory reset affects all bound project claims.
Receipts bind before/after hashes and replaying an accepted manifest is idempotent.
The complete P2 destructive negative suite passes and prior V4/V3 suites remain green.
